correctness.rationale: After the published cyclic-letter theorem normalizes a to the 8-cycle, full reachability forces other letter b to rank seven. Collision-pair/excluded-image/duplicated-image/bijection parametrization exhausts C(8,2)*8*7*6!=1,128,960 maps. Full-mask BFS on the 255 nonempty subsets calculates exact shortest-image distances; shortest-path dynamic programming along both labeled letter edges counts distinct words, not transformations. I implemented and ran independent C++ enumeration, independent of the repository source, obtaining 1,093,632 reachable maps, 544 violations, none at sizes other than six or lengths other than 17, precisely one exceptional antipodal-complement subset for each, target masks 119,187,221,238 (136 each), and multiplicity histogram 384/96/32/32. The repository contains reach_census.cpp and separately enumerating independent_waves.cpp; both were inspected with their bounded methodology. The cyclic-orbit quotient gives 68 equal eight-element orbits; no infinite-state claim is made.

final_claim: Every eight-state binary completely reachable automaton violating d(S)<=8(8-|S|) has exactly one exceptional subset, a six-element complement of an antipodal pair at distance 17. Among 1,093,632 normalized completely reachable automata, 544 violate, and shortest-reaching-word counts 2,3,4,5 occur for 384,96,32,32 of them; their 68 cyclic classes partition 48,12,4,4.
